title: Alert
description: Displays an important message inline, such as system notices or the result of an action.

props.name: title
props.description: Alert title (or the `title` slot)

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic (status) color, which also sets the default icon and the role

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual style: `subtle` (tinted background), `outline` (transparent
background with a colored border) or `solid` (filled with the color)

props.name: size
props.description: Alert size

props.name: showIcon
props.description: Shows the status icon of the color (or the `icon` slot)

props.name: closable
props.description: Shows a close button

props.name: animation
props.description: Plays an entrance animation

props.name: animationName
props.description: Entrance animation name

props.name: banner
props.description: Banner mode, suited to page-level notices at the top of a page

props.name: elevation
props.description: Adds a drop shadow

props.name: rounded
props.description: Rounds the corners

props.name: borderRadius
props.description: Custom corner radius (a number is in px)

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Lets the content be expanded and collapsed (requires a title)

props.name: expanded
props.description: Whether the content is expanded (controlled, `v-model:expanded`)

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the content is initially expanded (uncontrolled)

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the close button

props.name: expandLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the toggle while the content is collapsed

props.name: collapseLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the toggle while the content is expanded

props.name: iconLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the status icon

props.name: returnFocus
props.description:
Element receiving focus after the alert is closed with its close button:
an element, a ref or a getter. Without it focus moves to the next
focusable element after the alert (else the previous one, else its
container), never to <body>

props.name: role
props.description:
ARIA role of the alert. Danger and warning interrupt ("alert"), info
and success are polite ("status")

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Custom icon, replacing the status icon

slots.name: action
slots.description: Action area rendered on the right, e.g. buttons

vars.name: --alert-padding
vars.description: Padding (every size; defaults to the padding of the size)

vars.name: --alert-icon-size
vars.description: Size of the status icon (every size)

vars.name: --alert-gap
vars.description: Space between the icon, the content and the actions

vars.name: --alert-shadow
vars.description: Shadow of the elevated alert (defaults to --shadow-sm)

files.apps/docs/src/docs/pages/alert/vue/closa:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { Alert, Button, VStack } from "minerva-design/vue";
const visible = ref(true);
</script>
<template>
  <VStack :gap="3" align="stretch"
    ><Alert
      v-if="visible"
      closable
      title="Scheduled maintenance"
      @close="visible = false"
      >Service will restart tonight.</Alert
    ><Button v-else @click="visible = true">Restore notice</Button></VStack
  >
</template>

translationResources.title: Alert
translationResources.description: Displays an important message inline, such as system notices or the result of an action.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color sets the status: info (default), success, warning and danger. It also picks the icon and the role.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant sets the visual style: subtle (default, tinted background), outline (colored border) or solid (filled with the color).

with-title.title: With title
with-title.description: Add a title above the content. showIcon={false} hides the icon.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: closable adds a close button; closeIcon replaces its icon and onClose is called on close.

with-action.title: With action
with-action.description: Render buttons or links on the right with action.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: With a title, collapsible lets users expand and collapse the content. Control it with expanded + onExpand, or set only the initial state with defaultExpanded.

banner.title: Banner
banner.description: Banner mode for notices at the top of a page.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Custom icon, elevation, the outline and solid variants and corner radius options.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Choose the entrance animation or turn it off.

return-focus.title: Focus after closing
return-focus.description: Closing an alert with its close button never drops focus to the page: it moves to the next focusable element after the alert (else the previous one, else its container), or to returnFocus (an element, a ref or a function).

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Four status colors with a heading. Danger and warning alerts use role="alert", info and success role="status".

variants-sizes.title: Variants, sizes and appearance
variants-sizes.description: Three variants and sizes, hide-icon, elevation, square corners, animation-name / no-animation, a custom icon slot and banner mode.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: closable fires a cancelable minerva-close: preventDefault() keeps the alert, otherwise it moves focus out and hides itself. The action slot holds buttons.

collapsible.title: Collapsible
collapsible.description: collapsible (with a heading) adds a toggle; collapsed sets the initial state and minerva-expanded-change reports each change.

props.heading: Title text (or use the heading slot).
props.alertRole: ARIA role (default: "alert" for danger / warning, "status" otherwise).

events.minerva-close: The close button was activated; cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the alert visible.
events.minerva-expanded-change: The user expanded / collapsed the message (detail: { expanded }); cancelable.

slots.heading: Title (alternative to the heading attribute).
slots.icon: Custom icon replacing the status icon.
slots.action: Action area (e.g. buttons) at the end.

basic.description: Interact with the native component in this phone preview.
